what: Example imagery for the fictional Brightline Auto Care sample site. No photographs: two drawn illustrations, nothing AI-generated, nothing downloaded.

files.example-before.svg: Illustration: a dull, swirl-marked paint surface (1600x1200); the site labels both 'Example image' in its caption
files.example-after.svg: Illustration: the same surface after a polish, glossy with crisp reflections (1600x1200); the site labels both 'Example image' in its caption

source: Drawn by hand as SVG for this example (2026-11-05). Abstract on purpose: a close-up of a painted panel, not a car, so it cannot pass for anyone's real work.
honesty: The site's caption says 'Example image: an illustration, not real work.' Brightline's other three seed photos (802-804) are switched off by scripts/studio/example-engine.mjs rather than replaced with stand-ins.
history: Until 2026-11-05 this pair was a photograph of a black Scion FR-S that was thought to be the platform owner's. He confirmed it is not his, so it was removed from the example.
licence: Made for this project; no third-party material.
